terrainDescription.zh: 南部為熱帶雨林與三角洲，北部轉為薩赫爾草原
terrainDescription.en: Tropical rainforest and delta in the south, transitioning to Sahelian savanna in the north

plate.color: white background, black text; state flag/coat of arms upper-left, state name & slogan top-centre, "FEDERAL REPUBLIC OF NIGERIA" at bottom

roadInfra.bollardStyle: No strongly standardized bollard color pattern; some concrete median dividers painted green-and-white (flag colors). Not a reliable clue on its own — roads are often unmarked/faded/potholed instead

utilityPole.transformerMount: Ladder-style pole with rung-like indents/through-holes running up the shaft, distinguishable from Brazil's similar-looking ladder poles

historicalContext.zh: 官方統計超過250個民族語言，是非洲語言多樣性最高的國家之一，單一「國家語言」的概念並不適用。
historicalContext.en: Officially over 250 ethnolinguistic groups — one of Africa's most linguistically diverse countries; the idea of a single "national language" doesn't really apply.

note.zh: Ankara／蠟染布在市場很常見，但這種布料其實整個西非法語/英語系國家都普遍使用（迦納、多哥、貝南等皆有），不能單獨當奈及利亞的辨識證據；Aso-oke 織錦是約魯巴族特有的正式場合服飾，但日常街景較少見。
note.en: Ankara/wax-print fabric is common in markets, but it's widespread across West Africa (Ghana, Togo, Benin too) — not diagnostic of Nigeria alone. Aso-oke weave is a Yoruba formal-occasion textile, rarely seen in everyday street scenes.

culturalMarkers.caveat: Explicitly pan-regional — flag as low-confidence in UI, not a distinguishing clue on its own
